context: A boss and his manager discuss a policy column
purpose: Teach: 引き起こし/妨げ/党首/幕府/中傷/ワクチン/肺/上空

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: この記事、ワクチン誤情報が肺の検診を妨げた話だな。
lines.en: This article—it's about vaccine misinformation blocking lung cancer screenings.
lines.style: Measured opening, slightly angled inward as if reading. Pause at the dash. Steady throughline, no rush. The tone of someone thinking aloud while formulating the problem.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。党首発言が現場の混乱を引き起こしました。
lines.en: Yes. A statement from the party leadership created confusion out in the field.
lines.style: Respectful but direct. Clipped efficiency—no decoration. Speaks as someone reporting facts upward. Professional distance maintained but shoulders slightly forward.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 昔の幕府期に似てるな、と書き手は言ってる。
lines.en: The writer makes a parallel to the shogunate period—how information was controlled back then.
lines.style: Contemplative, slightly slower. Leans back slightly. The thoughtfulness of drawing a historical line. Faint emphasis on 'parallel' — this isn't casual, it's deliberate comparison.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 中傷の連鎖、上空から構造把握する必要があります。
lines.en: We need to step back and map the structure of how these rumors spread—the chain reaction.
lines.style: Quieter, more intent. Leaning in slightly. Searching for the right frame. 'Bird's-eye' precision but with urgency underneath. The voice of someone who sees the problem clearly and wants the boss to see it too.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 来月の経営会議で議題に。
lines.en: We'll bring it to next month's management meeting.
lines.style: Decisive, no softening. Direct gaze. Settled tempo. The syntax of resolution—something is decided and will move forward. No extra breath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Brief, clean acknowledgment. No flourish. The voice of someone filing the decision and moving to the next task. Quiet respect, zero hesitation.
